notes.title: Let's play Dolmenjord - Vilking Islands!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41937677/42c6d9a83597a15644ec5ec1dc89ad3c7411956e.png[/img]

Dolmenjord is a game inspired by Norse mythology, where Vikings need help to organize their buildings and villages and thus solve the puzzles and dominate new lands.

It is available now!

Great for Nordic culture fans who love to be challenged with logic puzzles.

Set up each village according to the rules:
- Place all the available houses and walkway pieces.
- Every house must face the walkway.
-  The completed walkway must give access to the port.

The puzzles are simple in the early islands, but it gets challenging as you advance in the exploration. If you prefer a more relaxing journey, that's fine!
Whenever you want, you can enable the Casual Mode.

notes.title: Mini Words: Polyglot gameplay in the Steam Digital Tabletop Fest!
notes.content:
Watch a gameplay session of Mini Words: Polyglot during the Steam Digital Tabletop Fest with our development team!

Mini Words: Polyglot is in the Steam Digital Tabletop Fest!
Enjoy a broadcast session in the Fest schedule on 23/Oct at 10 am PST (click [url=https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/fixedtime.html?msg=Gameplay+Broadcast&iso=20211023T10&p1=137&ah=2]here[/url] to convert to you local timezone).

The most used nouns in English. Can you recognize them in another language? Unscramble frequently used words in a unique mix of logic puzzle, word search, and hangman.

Challenge your vocabulary in languages around the world!
[list]
[*] Simple to start: boards are small and words are easily recognized, but the challenge grows as the levels advance.
[*] If you can't recognize a word, just refresh it to see it and listen to it in a different language.
[*] Great for experts in many languages, but also for those studying or simply curious about them.
[*] You can select the languages to want to see in the game and in which order.
[*] To start with, we offer Spanish, French, Portuguese (Brazilian), Russian, German, and Italian.
[/list]

Join us and play Mini Words: Polyglot!

notes.title: Island Farmer is available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35765065/344c38eb4bc78bc1ddf48368fa86f55d7ba57f8f.jpg[/img]

Farms are set up in islands over calm and clear water.
In this tiny fantasy experience, that is easy to do and very relaxing, just like a 3D jigsaw puzzle.

Swap the blocks to recreate the desired island and it will compose the archipelago.

There is no time limit, logic challenges, or resources to manage, so you can calmly just focus on the core mechanics while listening to a soothing soundtrack.
[list]
[*] Click on two blocks to swap them,
[*] Turn the camera around the island;
[*] Zoom in and out to see details or the big picture;
[*] Preview the expected arrangement.
[/list]
As you progress building the islands, see your archipelago expand and evolve in the background.
With clear skies, fresh air, and crystal clear water, among animals and listening to the sounds of nature.


Play it now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1564560/Island_Farmer__Jigsaw_Puzzle/

Follow us on Steam and keep up-to-date with our releases!

notes.title: Small update released - v1.0.02
notes.content:
Hi,
Thank you for playing Mini Words: Polyglot and for your feedback.
We've just released an update (version v1.0.02) with the reviewed translation of words in German, on levels, 72, 78, 93, 94, 145, 154, 160.
Thanks, Shiyo for sending the review. 

We worked with speakers of each language to provide translations, but there may still be imprecise information.
If you find a translation mistake and want to contribute to improving the game, feel free to send a message to contact@mensssanainteractive.com or to post in the community forum.

If you'd like to collaborate in the translation into new languages please contact us as well.

Best regards
